findings.evidence: `rg` shows the statement at line 72 is `¬ ((∃ i, D i = -4) ∧ (∃ i, D i = 8) ∧ (∃ i, D i = -8))`; the existing precedent is `not_all_three_evenPrimeDiscriminants_of_forall_isEvenPrimeDiscriminant_eq` in `PrimeDiscriminantIndependence.lean:244`, and Mathlib naming says theorem names describe their conclusions.
findings.fix: Rename it to match the adjacent generic theorem, e.g. `not_all_three_evenPrimeDiscriminants_negFourNegThreeNegSevenPrimeDiscriminants`, and update call sites.
findings.issue: `not_all_even_negFourNegThreeNegSevenPrimeDiscriminants` sounds like `¬ ∀ i, Even ...`, but the theorem excludes simultaneous occurrence of the three even prime discriminants `-4`, `8`, and `-8`.

summary: One public helper name understates and misdescribes its conclusion; the rest of the introduced names and notation are acceptable for this rubric.
